name: Jozabad
overview: Jozabad was a male Levite who served as an overseer of the consecrated things under Conaniah. His role involved responsibility over sacred duties, indicating a trusted position within the tribe of Levi. There are no additional notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jozabad means 'YHWH bestowed,' reflecting a recognition of God's provision or gift. This meaning highlights the theocentric nature of his identity as recorded in 2 Chronicles 31:13.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Jozabad as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe entrusted with temple service. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Jozabad's significance lies in his administrative oversight of sacred items during a period of temple reform and dedication. His service under Conaniah suggests a role in maintaining the holiness and order of worship, underscoring the importance of faithful stewardship in God's house.
